ai_summary.key_headline: Ronaldo's Last Dance: Portugal Battles Unbeaten European Champions Spain

spain: Yeremy Pino (Shoulder injury, potentially a broken collarbone, sustained during the match against Uruguay on June 27, 2026 - Out)
Nico Williams (Discomfort/hamstring injury sustained during the match against Uruguay on June 27, 2026. He has had ongoing groin issues and a previous hamstring injury earlier in May 2026 - Doubtful)
Lamine Yamal (Hamstring injury in May 2026 that ended his club season. He was on the bench at the start of the tournament due to this injury - Doubtful)
Víctor Muñoz (Muscle problem while recovering from a calf injury - Doubtful)

tactical_insights: Spain's dynamic wingers, Yamal and Williams, will test Portugal's aggressive high defensive line.
Spain enters the match unbeaten in the World Cup, yet to concede a single goal.
Spain's vertical, high-pressing style under De la Fuente contrasts with Portugal's expansive, possession-oriented approach.
